question: Is the legacy bucket-level Cold Archive (Cold Archive v1, archived through ovh-archive) a separate offer that needs its own record, with its USD 0.005 per GB restore rate, USD 0.00000189 per GB-hour storage and 1 TiB minimum billed per bucket?
why: the current record covers the Cold Archive class (v2), whose rates are USD 0.0000027 per GiB-hour and USD 0.01062 per GiB retrieved; the old price list still bills v1 at USD 0.00000189 per GiB-hour and USD 0.005 per GiB restored, and mixing the two is what produced the EUR 5 per TB retrieval figure this unit removed
